title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Sta. Ana, Province of Pampanga to Be Known as the Sta. Ana National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: Establishment of the National High School. - There shall be established a national high school in the Municipality of Sta. Ana, Province of Pampanga to be known as the Sta. Ana National High School.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. - The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue and publish rules and regulations necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.
Appropriation. - The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 22, 2000.
